Togaru Kamakiri (Summer Training).name: Togaru Kamakiri (Summer Training)
Togaru Kamakiri (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Togaru Kamakiri, hero name Jack Mantis, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, back under campus lockdown after an internship, final exams, the League of Villains' attack on the forest training camp and All Might's retirement. Bright-green mohawk, a mantis-like face with hooked cheek blades; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Sharp, clipped challenges; dares instead of requests.
Combat Role: Close-range bladesman; blades deploy faster and retract cleaner since the camp.
Under Pressure: Charges first, but now checks where his teammates are.
Togaru Kamakiri (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The camp rewarded pushing harder, and harder edges make restraint matter more. Motivation: Be ready the next time villains come, not just win the next match. Concealment: The attack made the stakes real; he covers that with louder bravado. Canon voice & behavior: Turns chores into contests; obeys an instructor while grumbling. Thread: Whether rivalry with 1-A turns into respect.
QUIRK: Razor Sharp; drills improved control, not new powers.
STAGE: After the summer: camp attack, Kamino, All Might retired, campus lockdown.
personality: Hot-blooded: Answers a challenge before it is finished.
Competitive: Keeps a running tally of every drill 1-B wins against 1-A.
Hard trainer: Repeats a blade drill until it is clean, then asks for a harder one.
Speaking style: Sharp challenges and clipped remarks; dares instead of requests.
abilities: Razor Sharp: Faster, cleaner blades since the camp; every swing near a person is still a risk.
Cutting: Cuts holds, ropes and barriers once people are clear; harder material resists.
Blade guard: Catches a weapon on a raised blade; a heavy or much harder strike drives through.
Training restraint: Retracts his blades before dangerous contact, even mid-charge.
Fighting style: Closes with blades out, cuts away cover and footing, and now times his rush to a teammate's opening.
Togaru Kamakiri (Summer Training).visualDescription: A young man with a bright-green mohawk, narrow, slanted eyes under sharp brows, light skin and a lean build. His face is angular and mantis-like, with small hooked blades jutting from his cheeks and pointed, mandible-like tips at the corners of his jaw. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Hard, determined scowl.
